major_cooldowns.name: Voidform
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it every 2 minutes once Shadow Word: Pain is on at least as many targets as Vampiric Touch, and pair it with Power Infusion and your on-use trinkets; every Shadow Word: Madness cast inside the window extends it, for roughly 10 extra seconds in practice.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 228260 is the cast id; 194249 is the Voidform aura and is what the Power Infusion rule checks.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Infusion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it inside Voidform every 2 minutes and sync Fireblood, Berserking, Blood Fury or Ancestral Call to the same window; with Twins of the Sun Priestess cast it on an ally so you get the full buff as well.

major_cooldowns.name: Halo
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Archon only: cast it on cooldown once every mob is engaged and in range, accepting that its 1 minute cooldown drifts further into each Voidform window over the pull.

major_cooldowns.name: Void Torrent
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Voidweaver only: channel it with Shadow Word: Madness active and both DoTs up, early in a burst window so its Insanity fuels the rest of it, and hold it up to 10 seconds in AoE when a pack is about to land.

defensives.name: Dispersion
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into a lethal hit or a heavy damage pattern for 75% reduction and a heal over its 6 seconds, accepting that you cannot attack while it is up.

defensives.name: Desperate Prayer
defensives.usage_rule: Use it at or below 75% health, typically after Shadow Word: Death backlash, for the instant heal and the raised health ceiling.

defensives.name: Vampiric Embrace
defensives.usage_rule: Pop it before raid damage lands so your single-target Shadow damage feeds 40% of itself back as healing for 12 seconds.

defensives.name: Fade
defensives.usage_rule: Drop threat with it while pulling alongside the tank so you can apply Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain as the pack gathers, and use it to shed aggro after an early burst window.

rules.description: Voidform into Power Infusion, then spend Insanity
rules.action: Pre-cast Vampiric Touch and Tentacle Slam, open with Shadow Word: Pain, then Halo as Archon, Voidform, trinkets and potion, Power Infusion, Shadow Word: Madness, Void Volley, and Void Torrent as Voidweaver.
Both are 2 minute cooldowns, so cast Power Infusion inside every Voidform and pull stat racials and on-use trinkets into the same 15 second window.

rules.description: Shadow Word: Madness before Void Torrent
rules.action: Land Shadow Word: Madness on the target before you channel Void Torrent: every tick re-checks Mastery, so the missing DoT costs damage on the whole 3 second channel.

rules.description: Vampiric Touch stays up on the target
rules.action: Target 99%+ Vampiric Touch uptime on priority targets, refreshing inside the pandemic window at 30% duration remaining, 6.3 seconds with Misery. Prefer Tentacle Slam for the refresh when a charge is up, and skip targets that will not live 12 seconds.

rules.description: Shadow Word: Pain stays up on the target
rules.action: Target 99%+ Shadow Word: Pain uptime, refreshing at 4.8 seconds remaining without Misery or 6.3 with it, and use it as your movement filler when no instant is available.

rules.description: Shadow Word: Madness stays up on the target
rules.action: Target 90%+ Shadow Word: Madness uptime: refresh at under a GCD remaining or once your Insanity deficit is 35 or less. The DoT rolls its remaining damage into the new ticks, so an early refresh to dodge an Insanity cap costs nothing.

rules.description: Shadow Word: Madness refreshed late, not clipped
rules.action: Let Shadow Word: Madness run down to under a GCD remaining, or your Insanity deficit to 35 or less, before recasting it: the remaining damage rolls into the new ticks at no cost, so refreshing early only trims your Mastery: Shadow Weaving uptime.

rules.description: Shadow Word: Death replaces Mind Flay in execute
rules.action: Below 20% target health, let Shadow Word: Death take over from Mind Flay: it hits harder in execute range and keeps its own cooldown moving instead of sitting idle.

source_summary: Shadow Priest builds Insanity with short-cooldown spells and spends it on Shadow Word: Madness while Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain never fall off, since Mastery: Shadow Weaving scales with all three DoTs on the target. Voidform and Power Infusion are the 2 minute burst pair and are cast together with stat racials, on-use trinkets and the potion; Halo (Archon) and Void Torrent (Voidweaver) fill the shorter cooldown layer and are used whenever they will not cost a short-cooldown cast. Tentacle Slam is the DoT-spreading cooldown and should never sit capped on charges, especially inside a burst window.
